correctness.rationale: A generic integral 1-parameter torus separates all nonzero root weights; fixed lines in P(g) are the Cartan projective component plus individual root lines. Nilpotent closure excludes all nonzero Cartan points. Minimal long-root nilpotent orbit lies in every nonzero nilpotent closure; short root vectors form one Weyl-conjugacy orbit. Euler characteristic of a projective C* variety equals that of its fixed locus, so chi is precisely the number of included root lines. Explicit B/C, F4, G2 root counts corroborate the type table; finite tests do not replace the all-rank proof. The theorem does not identify each short-orbit closure containment.
